authorization: User approved larger-cohort speed/coordination/variability SPPB comparison and dataset compatibility assessment.

datasets.gait2care: Zenodo17017009 v2; Week0 only; keep Week8 out of model development/evaluation this run

input_gate: IMU-derived stride metrics and original common-clock heel-strike events, not RGB or full-body 3D. Existing GDI model cannot accept these inputs. No CP GDI inference/training.
labels: Published SPPB total primary. TUG and SPPB balance/chair-stand subscore exploratory. Reject missing/invalid total; if total differs from recorded sum, exclude from primary and log, never repair. No exclusion by poor outcome. Age>=65.

features.speed: Mean stride speed across accepted straight strides (both feet pooled in gait2care). Not 4m test speed, which enters SPPB label.
features.variability: Stride duration, stride length and swing-percent CV. Pool within-foot centred sums of squares / pooled degrees of freedom, divide by grand mean*100. GSTRIDE single foot. Require>=15 accepted strides per observed foot. Use finite positive duration,length,speed and swing between0and100, absolute turning angle<20deg. No learned/outcome-dependent trimming.
features.coordination: PCI=100*sampleSD(phase)/mean(phase)+100*mean(abs(phase-180))/180; phase=360*(opposite HS - own HS)/(next own HS-own HS). Only valid source strides with exactly one opposite strike, each linked via segmentation sample to timestamp_NoCal. Average two foot PCI; >=15 phases each. Do not substitute calibrated per-foot clocks. No cross-gap cycles. Availability gate before fitting.

evaluation: Within each dataset independent person5-fold outer shuffled seed20261103; inner3-fold shuffled seed20261031. Ridge alpha[0.1,1,10,100,1000], training-only mean/SD, select smallest inner person MAE. No output clipping. All conditions on common eligible participants; GSTRIDE A/C only. Also training mean/median controls. Save train/test IDs, every inner/final fit, predictions, scalers and selected settings. No repeated seed selection.
external_gate: Train GSTRIDE then evaluate GAIT2CARE common A/C features without target tuning only if cross-cohort identity independence can be established. Otherwise label as provisional cross-dataset transfer, not independently verified external test; do not pool cohorts. Screen matching raw-file hashes and available demographic fingerprints; absence of a match alone cannot prove independence.
metrics: Person MAE,RMSE,bias,R2,Spearman,within1,abs error>2. SPPB bands0-4,5-8,9-10,11-12; fixed predicted<=8 detection TP,FN,TN,FP. Paired fixed-OOF bootstrap10000 seed20261103 CI95 for B-A,C-A,D-A,D-C. Conditional interval not full retraining uncertainty. Primary inference D-A in GAIT2CARE and C-A in GSTRIDE; no claim of improvement if interval includes zero.
verification: Source workbook MD5, retrieved member ZIP CRC32 and local SHA256; full archive MD5 not claimed for range extraction. Check clinical sum and ID joins, phase clocks, person separation and train-only preprocessing. Independently recompute ridge coefficients, replay all saved fits and recompute primary metrics. Hash protocol before fit. Report unresolved anatomy, timing, sampling/population limits.
status: Protocol frozen after schema/readme audit and before any model fit. Downloaded sources retain original values.
